Change c0069. Location: 1818 Vol. I, Ch. II; 1831 Ch. III.

Context before (unchanged): It was very different, when the masters of the science sought immortality and power; such views, although futile, were grand: but now the scene was changed.

1818 text: The ambition of the inquirer seemed to limit itself to the annihilation of those visions on which my interest in science was chiefly founded.

1831 text: The ambition of the enquirer seemed to limit itself to the annihilation of those visions on which my interest in science was chiefly founded.

Diff: The ambition of the [-inquirer-] {+enquirer+} seemed to limit itself to the annihilation of those visions on which my interest in science was chiefly founded.

Context after (unchanged): I was required to exchange chimeras of boundless grandeur for realities of little worth.

result.rationale: Only the orthography changes: 'inquirer' becomes 'enquirer' with identical wording and meaning, the kind of spelling variation the 1831 edition makes throughout.
